linuxProof.nodeArchiveVerification: Official nodejs.org SHASUMS256.txt verified before extraction; sha256sum returned OK.
linuxProof.relocation: The initial WSL command expanded its temporary-path variable unexpectedly, creating new /app and /toolchain directories. Both were task-created (mkdir without -p succeeded), their exact identities and package/lock hashes were checked, then they were moved into the recorded dedicated persistent proof directory. No existing source checkout was moved. See relocate-vercel-proof.sh.

cloudSetup.environment: Vercel's platform VERCEL=1 and VERCEL_URL select and validate hosted foundation mode. Optional explicit QUELLIGHT_MODE=foundation and QUELLIGHT_DEPLOYMENT=hosted. Do not copy the local .env.example settings into a hosted environment.
cloudSetup.uploads: .vercelignore excludes engineering records, test/probe scripts, local output, environment files, Git state and Node-only deployment files. Required source/config/build script/lock/baseline/six archives are retained.

limits: Builder checks are separate from independent review.
No Vercel resource or deployment was created by this build workstream; a Linux artifact is not live-host evidence.
The function remains foundation-only and cannot enable owner authentication, conversation, memory, storage or providers with environment flags.
The 30-second cap is for the empty foundation; governed jobs and streaming require later qualified route budgets and durable coordination.
Vercel controls Node minor and patch rollout; hosted runtime must be checked separately.
The existing broad VICT catalog client chunk remains about 1.64 MB (about 442 kB gzip).
The added low audit entry is adapter-vercel inheriting existing SvelteKit advisories; no broad framework upgrade was performed.
Canary and artifact-path inspection are bounded checks, not proof that all future secret or log paths are safe.
